fact: As of mid-2026 Zimbabwe's National AI Strategy 2026-2030, approved by Cabinet in October 2025 and launched on 13 March 2026, is not a law, the proposed National Digital Regulatory Committee and National AI Council have no Act behind them, and the Cyber and Data Protection Act [Chapter 12:07] is the law that applies to automated decisions.
title: Strategy without statute: A reading of Zimbabwe's national AI strategy
